name: DescriptionList
purpose: Read-only term-and-description facts with semantic description-list relationships.

guidance.useWhen: Use for labeled facts, attributes, metadata, or key/value details where terms describe one or more values.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for tabular comparisons that require row and column relationships or for interactive form fields.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use semantic dl/dt/dd markup until a renderer exists; when DescriptionList is available, preserve the same term/description structure and do not invent a stateful data API.

accessibility: Preserve native description-list term and description relationships; do not replace them with generic grouping roles.
preserves native description-list semantics for term and description relationships
projected content must retain semantic term and description structure rather than generic grouping roles
knownLimitations: Renderer implementations remain deferred to the framework-specific DescriptionList tasks.
